keyPoints: Dvighaat samikaran ka roop: ax^2 + bx + c = 0, jahan a kabhi 0 nahi hota.
Gunankhand vidhi: x^2 + 5x + 6 = 0 -> (x+2)(x+3) = 0 -> x = -2 ya x = -3.
Vivechak (discriminant) D = b^2 - 4ac: D > 0 to do alag mool, D = 0 to do barabar mool, D < 0 to koi vaastavik mool nahi.
Moolon ka yog = -b/a aur moolon ka gunanfal = c/a.
Purna varg vidhi: x^2 + 6x + 5 = 0 -> (x+3)^2 = 4 -> x = -1 ya x = -5.
subject: Maths
title: Dvighaat Samikaran
